Projects

Case studies & coursework

01

Earned-Value Project Controls Dashboard

Independent case study · In progress
Problem
Portfolio reports often show spend on its own, without telling you whether each project is on budget and on schedule at the same time.
Approach
A SQL database of synthetic project data feeding a Power BI dashboard: budget vs. actual, CPI and SPI per project, earned-value S-curves, and an estimate-at-completion forecast.
Result
In progress. Results will be added here when the build is complete.
Repo
Link will be added on completion.
02

Invoice OCR & Computer Vision Pipeline

George Brown Polytechnic · Deep Learning II (team project)
Problem
Invoices arrive as images, but finance teams need the key fields (totals, payment terms, due dates, reference numbers) as structured data before they can act on them.
Approach
CNN feature learning and SSD-style region detection evaluated with IoU, OCR run only on detected regions, then extraction of payment terms and due dates. Served through FastAPI and Streamlit, containerized with Docker on a GCP Compute Engine VM.
Result
An end-to-end demo that turns an invoice image into a structured JSON record, deployed on GCP.
Repo
github.com/RV922/DL2_InvoiceAI
